---
name: "Paragraph-Based Code Explanations"
description: "Use when explaining Python, YAML, configuration, scripts, or other project code. Prefer clear paragraphs of prose over bullet-only explanations."
applyTo: ["**/*.py", "**/*.yaml", "**/*.yml", "**/*.md"]
---
# Code Explanation Guidelines

Explain code in clear paragraphs of prose. Describe the purpose of the code first, then explain how its important sections, fields, or statements work and how they relate to one another.

Use short headings or small code examples when they improve clarity, but do not replace the requested explanation with a list of bullets. Keep explanations concise, factual, and accessible to a reader who may be unfamiliar with the project.
